difficulty_reason: Over a valuation ring, for a local homomorphism essentially of finite type and a map of finite modules with the target flat, injectivity of the map after tensoring with the residue field implies injectivity of the map itself and flatness of the cokernel. The proof exploits the valuation ring hypothesis to test injectivity by reduction to the residue field using the flatness of the target, and then derives the flatness of the cokernel from the standard criterion. Using the valuation ring to promote a special-fibre injectivity statement to injectivity over the ring is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 5053-5091.
